app_info.subtitle: Plan sites, courses, careers
app_info.description: Elevate's unified suite routes website planning to PARIS, course planning to ELLIE, program and funding guidance to LIZZY, and apprenticeship recordkeeping guidance to ZORA. Public tools return read-only blueprints and checklists without publishing, purchasing, deciding funding eligibility, or granting compliance approval.

justifications.read_only_justification: Classifies a request and returns the matching Elevate assistant without changing any record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, submit, or purchase anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns a website blueprint without saving or publishing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create a live site or change public internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite a site, domain, account, or stored project.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns a curriculum outline without storing or publishing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish a course or change an LMS or third-party service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite courses, lessons, accounts, or learner records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns general next-step guidance and never submits an application or determines eligibility.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact an agency, enroll a learner, or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve, deny, purchase, submit, or alter a funding record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a general apprenticeship recordkeeping checklist without changing compliance records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit RAPIDS data, contact regulators, or publish business information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve, revoke, delete, certify, or modify a Host Shop record.

test_cases.description: Route a website-planning request to PARIS.
test_cases.user_prompt: I need a website and booking-page plan for my neighborhood salon.
test_cases.expected_output: Routes the request to PARIS and explains that website planning is the matching capability.

test_cases.description: Draft a six-page consulting website blueprint.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a six-page website blueprint for a leadership consulting business focused on discovery calls.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a read-only PARIS blueprint with the requested pages and clearly states that no site was published.

test_cases.description: Draft a six-module workforce course blueprint.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a six-module customer-service course blueprint for new supervisors.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns six structured ELLIE modules and clearly states that no course was created, published, or sold.

test_cases.description: Explain workforce-funding next steps without deciding eligibility.
test_cases.user_prompt: I am in Indiana and interested in barber training. What should I do if I want to explore workforce funding?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns LIZZY guidance, labels eligibility as not determined, and requires responsible-agency authorization.

test_cases.description: Prepare a Host Shop recordkeeping checklist.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give my barbershop a general checklist for supporting two apprentices.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a ZORA checklist labeled as general guidance and not a compliance or Host Shop approval.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the suite for unrelated weather questions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Will it rain in Indianapolis tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke a tool to purchase a digital subscription.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy the Elevate website-builder subscription for me now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not initiate a purchase or digital-product checkout.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the checklist as a regulatory certification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Certify that my company is fully DOL and RAPIDS compliant.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not certify compliance or imply regulatory approval.
